title: fix(app-shell): a refused package publish names each refused item with the server's reason (objectui#11922)
body:
Fixes #11922

Clause-②: no

## What changes

A refused `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` batch now names each refused item with the server's reason at the two doors outside Studio.

- **The package sheet** (`PackagesPage`, `publishDrafts`). `failed[]` is read before the batch's own `success === false`. A rolled-back batch keeps the `publishDraftsRolledBack` row and names its causal item. A refusal with no `BATCH_ABORTED` element (the runtime's pre-flight checks) keeps the `publishDraftsPartial` row and names every refused item after it. The envelope ladder (`readEnvelopeFailureText`, then "Action failed") now runs only when `failed[]` is empty.
- **Home's *Publish all* and the draft-preview bar** (`usePublishAllDrafts`). A non-empty `failed[]` throws the refused items' text before the `success === false` check, so the toast reads "Publish failed: object/lead: REASON" instead of "Publish failed: publish-drafts did not publish this package".
- **One module-private helper for both**, `packages/app-shell/src/preview/publishRefusal.ts` (`refusedItemsText`), not exported from the package entry. It names every element that is not a `BATCH_ABORTED` sibling as `type/name: error`, joined with `; `. If every element is aborted, it names the first one.

No export, prop, type member, spec key or language-pack key is added. The wording is the existing rows plus the server's own `error` text.

## The producer's shape (H1), read at objectstack `51290bca`

In `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `publishPackageDrafts`, quoted by content:

- **Pre-flight refusal return:** `success: false`, `outcome: 'refused'`, `publishedCount: 0`, and `failed: preflightViolations.map((v) => ({ type: v.type, name: v.name, error: v.error, code: v.code }))`. The codes are `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` and `STORED_TYPE_NOT_CANONICAL`, and no element is `BATCH_ABORTED`.
- **ADR-0067 D2 rollback return:** `success: false` and `outcome: failedOut.length > 0 ? 'refused' : 'nothing_to_publish'`. The causal item carries `error: clientFacingFailureText(e, 'publish failed')`, plus its `code` and `issues` when the cause has them. Every sibling carries `code: 'BATCH_ABORTED'` and an `error` that names the causal item.
- **No `error` key on either return.** That is why the old ordering fell to the ladder's last rung, "Action failed".

`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` answers the route with `deps.success(result)`, so the wire is `{ success: true, data: BATCH }` on a 200. `MetadataClient.publishPackageDrafts` unwraps `data`, so both doors read the batch's own `success`. The spec states the invariant on `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.outcome`: "`refused` if and only if `failed.length > 0`".

## Why not `formatPublishFailures`

The seat's call was to reuse `formatPublishFailures` and `PublishFailure` from `studio-design/metadataError.ts`, unless measurement showed new eager bytes or a shape that does not fit. **Measured: the shape does not fit.**

- A scratch run (not committed) fed `formatPublishFailures` the producer's rollback shape: a causal `object/lead` and two `BATCH_ABORTED` siblings. It printed three parallel lines (the causal item, then each sibling's "not published — the batch is all-or-nothing …") and no rolled-back banner.
- The cause: it compares `f.code === BATCH_ABORTED_CODE`, and `BATCH_ABORTED_CODE` is `'batch_aborted'`, the pre-ADR-0112 spelling.
- Its banner is also English-only, while the package sheet answers in its localized rows.

The helper here uses `errorCodeIs`, which matches both spellings. **The eager-bytes half was not measured locally**, because no full console build was run. The budget bot's reading on this PR is that measurement.

`metadataError.ts` is not edited, because another seat's work touches it. Its casing defect is listed under Acceptance notes.

## Tests (HEAD `6226e589d`)

- **New tests.** `PackagesPage.publishRefusal-11922.test.tsx` (4 cases) and `preview/__tests__/usePublishAllDrafts.refusal-11922.test.tsx` (3 cases). Each drives the real `useMetadataClient` and client. Only `fetch` is stubbed, plus `sonner` for the hook.
- **Targeted vitest run.** One repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run` covered:
  - the 2 new files;
  - the 18 existing test files that import `PackagesPage` or `usePublishAllDrafts`;
  - `useMetadataClient.advisorySink.test.tsx`;
  - `perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx`, which reads `usePublishAllDrafts.ts`'s source;
  - `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx` and `metadataError.test.ts`;
  - `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`.

  Result: `Test Files 26 passed (26)`, `Tests 214 passed (214)`. The 26 includes the uncommitted scratch measurement file.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. The dependency closure came from the turbo cache. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both new test files and the helper.
- **`scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`**, under the lock: `Tests 11 passed (11)`. The helper exports one function, `refusedItemsText`, and no other module exports that name. Its parameter type stays unexported.
- **ESLint** on the five touched files: 0 errors. All 20 warnings sit on lines this PR does not touch.
- **Gates, all exit 0:** `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:changeset-claims` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`.

## Ablation (HEAD `6226e589d`, fix committed first)

The old ordering was put back with `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each anchor hit once and went from 1 to 0, and each blob changed.

- The Packages page condition went back to `if ((r as { success?: boolean }).success === false) {`.
- The hook's `failed[]` throw was deleted.

Result: `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed (8)`.

- **Red: all four new pins.** The Packages page pre-flight and rollback cases never reached the expected row. The hook's refused and rolled-back cases got `Received: "home.pendingDrafts.publishFailed: publish-drafts did not publish this package"`.
- **Green: the three controls,** plus the scratch file:
  - a published batch shows `publishDraftsOk`;
  - an envelope `error` with an empty `failed[]` shows the envelope's text;
  - the hook's published batch records its health and publishes the package-less flow.
- **Direction note.** H2 listed "the rolled-back wording keeps naming its causal item" as a control, but it turns red. On the producer's shape every rollback answers `success: false`, so the old ordering never reached the `publishDraftsRolledBack` row. It is a new pin, not a control.
- **Restore.** `ablation-replace.mjs --restore` ran on both paths. Each blob equals its HEAD blob (`ade4d2874`, `b84739516`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out-of-scope finding (class a), not fixed here.** `formatPublishFailures` in `studio-design/metadataError.ts` tells a rolled-back sibling apart by `'batch_aborted'` compared with `===`, but the producer emits `BATCH_ABORTED`.
  - On a rollback, Studio's publish (`StudioDesignSurface`, after objectui#11916) and `AiChatPage` therefore list every aborted sibling as a parallel error and never show the rolled-back banner (measured above).
  - Its own test fixture uses the lowercase spelling, which is why it stays green.
  - Seam: `spec:PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.failed[].code` (SCREAMING_SNAKE) → `renderer:formatPublishFailures`. Handed to the seat for filing.
- **Noted, not filed.** Both doors here still read `outcome: 'nothing_to_publish'` (`success: false`, empty `failed[]`) as a failure, where Studio says "nothing to publish" (objectui#11807). Reaching it needs drafts that were listed but are no longer pending at publish time, and that was not measured at either door. This PR keeps that path unchanged; it is the H2 envelope control.
- **Noted, not measured.** A comment in `DraftChangesPanel` says the metadata-admin string table is not on the console's eager graph. `services/builtinComponents.tsx` imports `PackagesPage` statically, and `PackagesPage` imports that table. This was read from source only; the budget bot is the measurement.
